limitations: Egg-crate orientation mapping follows the corrected user-supplied workbook headings. Independent verification against the governing published specification has not been performed.
SC!A158 identifies interpolation but does not contain filled interpolation formulas; the application interpolates the source tabulated values.
Egg-crate tables cover R1/R2 0.2 to 1.8 and angles 0 to 40 degrees. Separate shading tables cover R 0.1 to 3 and angles 0 to 50 degrees.
